summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K announcing it has signed a EUR 247 million EIFO-backed senior secured green term loan facility to partly finance construction of its third A-class newbuild offshore wind installation vessel, Wind Apex. The 12-year facility is supported by the Export and Investment Fund of Denmark and designated as green financing under Cadeler's Green Finance Framework. The lending syndicate includes HSBC, KfW IPEX-Bank, Cooperative Rabobank U.A., and DNB Bank ASA. This is a routine debt financing arrangement, not a special situation. No transaction price, premium, or change of control is involved.
